projects.name: Raven
projects.description:
Raven is a self-hosted mail client for Gmail, Outlook, Yahoo, iCloud, Fastmail, Proton (through Bridge) and any IMAP/SMTP mailbox. It runs in the browser or as a desktop app.

It doesn't keep a password database. Your mail login lives only in an encrypted cookie in your own browser. Remote images and trackers stay blocked until you click, and emails open in a sandboxed frame with no scripts.

The Overview page shows who is waiting on your reply and who owes you one. Ask Jev lets you search your inbox with a plain question, and every answer shows the emails it came from. Raven never writes text with AI. Without an API key it uses Kage, a small built-in engine that works offline.

Raven is AGPL-3.0 and has been public since October 2026. Live demo: https://raven-mail.vercel.app
